_comment: Tier-2: the KratosChimeraApplication wheel ships the pybind module but omits libKratosChimeraApplicationCore.so, so the import fails after a SUCCESSFUL pip install. Pitfall (kratos.chimera #1). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). MEASURED CORRECTION TO THE VERSION CLAIM: the pitfall pins this to the 10.4.2 wheel; the defect is UNFIXED at 10.4.3. KratosChimeraApplication==10.4.3 installs cleanly and then import KratosMultiphysics.ChimeraApplication raises ImportError 'libKratosChimeraApplicationCore.so: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory'. This is a different failure from a missing wheel — the module IS present on disk, which is why 'pip install succeeded' is not evidence the application works. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass. INDEX SHIFTED by the guidance reclassification; the claim this fixture verifies is unchanged and every #index quoted above is the current one. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 INVERTS every claimed availability flag in CASES -- it asserts the opposite of what this install actually provides, leaving the importlib.import_module probe itself untouched. All 2 importable[...] lines then disagree with themselves and app_import_mismatches goes from 0 to 2. This is the control the fixture needs: it proves the printed booleans come from a real import attempt on this build and that a wrong availability claim is caught, rather than the fixture echoing a hard-coded table. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: all 2 importable[<app>]=<got>_expected=<must> lines, app_import_mismatches=0. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/chimera_wheel_installs_but_import_fails && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
